description: Drug class lookup — Drug classes and class members from NLM RxClass (FDA DailyMed pharmacologic classes + VA MED-RT). drug= (generic or brand) or rxcui= returns the FDA established pharmacologic class, mechanism of action, physiologic effect, chemical structure, conditions it may treat or prevent, and contraindications. class= (FDA class name or common term: statin, SSRI, ACE inhibitor, beta blocker, GLP-1, NSAID, PPI, DOAC...) returns the member drugs; condition= (Hypertension, migraine, high blood pressure, asthma...) returns drugs that may treat or prevent it (salt forms merged). Optional limit= 1-200 (default 50). Reference data, not medical advice. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_drug_class
